one_sentence_strategy_summary: The agent wrote a brute-force enumeration solver but had an initial budget-constraint sign error that produced an infeasible solution; after self-diagnosing the mistake at step 4, it rewrote the solver with correct expenditure-only constraints and produced the correct optimal solution (A=y, B=n, C=y, NPV=299).
